features.name: age_group
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: patient age derived from the original age-in-days field. In this repository it is represented as a processed or binned numeric feature.

features.name: gender
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: patient gender category, encoded numerically.

features.name: height_bin
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: patient height. The CAIM preprocessing discretizes height into interval-style categorical values.

features.name: weight_bin
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: patient weight. The CAIM preprocessing discretizes weight into interval-style categorical values.

features.name: systolic_pressure_bin
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: systolic blood pressure, originally named ap_hi. The CAIM preprocessing discretizes this measurement into interval-style categorical values.

features.name: diastolic_pressure_bin
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: diastolic blood pressure, originally named ap_lo. The CAIM preprocessing discretizes this measurement into interval-style categorical values.

features.name: cholesterol
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: cholesterol category, typically encoded as normal, above normal, or well above normal.

features.name: glucose
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: glucose category, typically encoded as normal, above normal, or well above normal.

features.name: alcohol_intake
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: alcohol intake indicator.

features.name: physical_activity
features.description: Cardiovascular dataset variable: physical activity indicator.

features.name: cardio
features.description: Prediction target for the cardiovascular task: whether the patient has cardiovascular disease.
